verdict.rationale: Asana documents an official MCP server. The docs include a usage guide (natural-language task and project management, reports), a supported-clients page, and an integration guide for registering MCP apps in the developer console. A tools reference covers read tools and interactive confirmation tools in Claude and ChatGPT, and a probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting and working through the server.
